name: LoginHue Admin Login Customiser
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
LoginHue Admin Login Customiser allows you to fully customize the WordPress admin login page using a clean and simple settings panel.

You can replace the default WordPress branding with your own logo, customize background colors or images, style the login form, inputs, buttons, and links, and add custom messages or footer text — all without writing any code.

This plugin is perfect for developers, agencies, freelancers, and site owners who want a professional, branded login experience for their websites or client projects.

Features

  • Enable or disable login customization
  • Set a custom admin login URL (optional)
  • Change the default wp-admin slug name
  • Upload a custom login logo or use a logo URL
  • Control logo width and height
  • Set a custom logo link URL
  • Option to hide the default WordPress logo

Background Customization
* Change login page background color
* Set a background image
* Control background size, position, and repeat

Login Form Styling
* Change login form background color
* Control form width
* Set border radius
* Advanced box shadow options:
* Horizontal and vertical offset
* Blur radius
* Spread radius
* Inset shadow
* Shadow color and opacity

Input Fields Styling
* Input background color
* Input text color
* Input border color
* Input border radius

Button Styling
* Login button background color
* Button hover color
* Button text color
* Button border radius

Text & Links
* Login text color
* Link color
* Link hover color

Extra Options
* Add a custom login message (HTML supported)
* Add custom footer text
* Hide “Lost your password?” link
* Hide “Back to site” link
* Hide “Remember me” checkbox
* Reset all settings to default values
sections.installation:
1. Upload the loginhue-admin-login-customiser folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → LoginHue Login Customiser.
  4. Configure your login page settings and click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No. All customization options are available through a simple settings page.

Will this plugin affect my active theme or frontend design?

No. It only affects the WordPress admin login page.

Can I reset all settings to default?

Yes. You can reset everything using the Reset to defaults button.

Is this plugin compatible with multisite?

Yes. It works on multisite installations, but settings apply per site unless network-activated.
